home.what_is_body: Baaruveri (“empowered”) is a civic platform that makes per-island accountability legible. Anonymous reading and discussion; eFaas-verified signatures and flagged-issue posting. A concept prototype, not an official Government of Maldives product.

atlas.title: Per-island civic profiles
atlas.subtitle: Atlas · 6 islands · v0 prototype
atlas.lede: Six representative islands across the Maldives: the capital and its reclaimed neighbour, two regional cities, one single-island atoll, and one small island whose USD 60M+ ADFD-funded airport made it the country's most-questioned public investment.
atlas.footnote: Population figures from NBS census (2024). Voter registers from Elections Commission, dated 2026-04-04. Budget figures are illustrative for the prototype pending live council data feeds. Open data: every aggregate above is downloadable as CSV (coming next).
atlas.map_footnote: Six islands featured (filled polygons + ★ in the side list) — click to open the full profile. Other inhabited islands click to fly the map to their position. Geometry from OneMap.mv, the public Maldives geospatial dataset.
atlas.list_aria_label: Inhabited islands grouped by atoll, north to south
atlas.list_load_error: Could not load the island list. The map still works.
atlas.list_footnote: ★ = full profile available. Tap others to fly the map.
atlas.ladder_footnote: The 26 administrative atolls run roughly 870 km north to south. Six are featured on Baaruveri; click a marker for that island's full profile.

island.section_council_meta_hdc: Administered by HDC · 3 citizen liaison reps shown
island.footnote: Source notes · Population: {pop_label} {pop_year}. Voters: {voter_label}, dated {voter_date}. Budget figures illustrative until live council quarterly returns wire. Threads and petitions are seed content for v0; real participation opens with eFaas integration.

sandbar.title: Threaded debate by issue × island
sandbar.subtitle: Sandbar · v0 prototype
sandbar.lede: A space for citizens, journalists, and councils to argue claims with sources, side by side. Anonymous tier for everyday speech; eFaas-verified tier for high-stakes acts. Civic-data sidebar attaches relevant per-island context to every thread.
sandbar.footnote: v0 hero thread is the Maafaru airport public-benefit accounting thread — fully wired with seven seeded claims and the civic-data sidebar. Other threads route to a stub page until v1.

thread.v0_stub_title: Full thread page coming in v1
thread.v0_stub_body: The Maafaru airport thread is the v0 hero — fully wired with claims, civic-data sidebar, and the Pros/Cons primitive. Other threads route here. The metadata, summary, and stats above are real fixture data that will populate the full thread page in the next milestone.

petition.threshold_council_body: Per-island petitions reaching 5% of registered voters (floor 100, ceiling 500) require a written council response within 30 days.
petition.threshold_parliament_body: Petitions reaching 5,000 signatures nationally are placed on the next available parliamentary agenda for debate.
petition.threshold_verification_body: Every signature passes through eFaas to prevent duplicates. Verified-rate is published with the count so journalists can judge signal quality.
petition.sign_with_efaas_helper: eFaas verification is required to sign. Anonymous comments elsewhere on Baaruveri don't require it. The eFaas check prevents duplicate signatures and is what makes the signature count enforceable against the government.
petition.signing_as: Signing as {name_dv} ({name_en}). Your name will be public on the petition's signatory page.
petition.signed_thanks: Signed — thank you for adding your name.
petition.signed_recorded_under: Recorded under {name_dv} ({name_en}). You can withdraw your signature any time before close — feature lands with the next petition iteration.
petition.synthetic_baseline_footnote: Signature count includes a seeded prior-signatures baseline plus this session's signs. Real eFaas-verified persistence arrives post-v0.

petitions_index.subtitle: Petitions · v0 prototype
petitions_index.lede: Per-island petitions reaching 5% of registered voters (floor 100, ceiling 500) require a written council response within 30 days. Petitions reaching 5,000 signatures nationally are placed on the next available parliamentary agenda. Every signature passes through eFaas to prevent duplicates.
petitions_index.footnote: Signature counts include this session's signs accumulated in the signatures table; the seed counts represent prior signatures (synthetic baseline). Real persistence with eFaas verification arrives post-v0.

auth.efaas_helper: In production, this is the redirect to the Maldives Government digital identity service. For the v0 prototype, choose a verified test citizen below to continue.
auth.efaas_warning: ⚠ Public picker — anyone can pick any persona. Posts, signatures, and votes are attributed to the chosen persona but carry no real identity proof. Real eFaas verification is post-v0.
auth.efaas_footer: Stub identity sets a signed httpOnly cookie. No data is sent off this machine. Real eFaas integration follows Maldives Government OIDC and is gated by an MOU.

datasets.title: Open data
datasets.subtitle: Open data · v0
datasets.lede: Every aggregate Baaruveri publishes is downloadable as CSV and queryable as JSON, no signup. Per the project commitment to open-data parity: anything you see on a dashboard view should be available raw, citable, and machine-readable.
datasets.council_budgets_body: Allocated and spent figures by line item, per island, per fiscal quarter. Includes year-over-year delta. Total FY26 allocation covered: MVR {total}.
datasets.footnote: Source notes · v0 figures are illustrative pending live council quarterly returns. Intended licence for v1: Open Database License (ODbL). Per-island per-issue datasets (housing, climate, EIA permits, procurement) follow as those primitives ship.

takedowns.page_lede: Every removal happens via the protocol in the <policy>moderation policy</policy>. Each row below is a removed post: what was taken down, why, and how the appeal went. Public so we can be held to it.
takedowns.empty: No takedowns yet. When the first one happens, the protocol — report, 24h human review, written rationale, public log entry — runs end to end and the row lands here.
takedowns.footnote: Removable categories are the narrow list in moderation policy §04. Anything that fell outside that list and was still removed should be in the appeals queue.
